name: Penrose Deflation Lumina
promptTemplate: A Penrose rhombus tiling in {{palette}} with {{edge_style}} lines, zooming at {{zoom_speed}} with travelling wave speed {{wave_speed}} and glow at {{glow_intensity}}.

edge_style.hint: Set rhombus boundary thickness and mood

zoom_speed.hint: Rate of recursive deflation into infinity

wave_speed.hint: Speed of radial light ripples across tiles

glow_intensity.hint: Amp up luminescence on travelling waves

gallery.blurb: A Penrose rhombus tiling generated by deflation, zooming slowly so each new generation subdivides into view, tiles tinted by type with a travelling highlight.
gallery.prompt: A Penrose rhombus tiling generated by deflation, zooming slowly so each new generation subdivides into view, tiles tinted by type with a travelling highlight. Build it with a demoscener's economy: one core technique done well, lookup tables and fixed-size buffers kept in room.state, nothing allocated inside hot loops, a steady 60fps at 1920x1080, and compact, clearly named code.
